```yaml
name: Skill Check with Token Usage Dashboard

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  evaluate-skills:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          dotnet restore
          dotnet build --no-restore
          
      - name: Run skill validation
        id: run-evaluation
        run: |
          dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator -- --evaluate
          
      - name: Upload token metrics artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-metrics
          path: token-usage.json
          retention-days: 30

  generate-dashboard-data:
    needs: evaluate-skills
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Download token metrics
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          workflow: evaluation.yml
          name: token-metrics
          path: ./artifacts/
          
      - name: Generate dashboard data
        run: |
          # Create directory structure for dashboard data
          mkdir -p dashboard/data
          
          # Process token metrics and generate dashboard format
          powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1
          
      - name: Upload dashboard data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: dashboard/
          retention-days: 30

  render-dashboard:
    needs: generate-dashboard-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Download dashboard data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: dashboard/
          
      - name: Render dashboard
        run: |
          # Render the dashboard using node.js
          npm install
          node ./dashboard/token-usage.js
          
      - name: Publish dashboard
        uses: testspace-com/setup-testspace@v1
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_DOMAIN }}
          token: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}
          config-args: "--publish dashboard/index.html"
          
      - name: Display test summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: "**/test-results.xml"
          output: summary.md
          show: always
          
      - name: Notify Slack
        if: failure()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v2.1.1
        with:
          method: chat.postMessage
          token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
          payload: |
            {
              "channel": "${{ secrets.SLACK_CHANNEL_ID }}",
              "text": "Skill check workflow failed",
              "blocks": [
                {
                  "type": "section",
                  "text": {
                    "type": "mrkdwn",
                    "text": ":warning: *Skill Check Workflow Failed*\nWorkflow: ${{ github.workflow }}\nRun: ${{ github.run_number }}\nURL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }

  benchmark:
    needs: evaluate-skills
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Run benchmarks
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: Token Usage Benchmark
          tool: custom
          output-file-path: benchmark-results.json
          gh-pages-branch: gh-pages
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          auto-push: true
          save-data-file: true
          
      - name: Publish benchmark results
        uses: testspace-com/setup-testspace@v1
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_DOMAIN }}
          token: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}
          config-args: "--publish benchmark-results.json"
```
